name: Residential & High-Rise Moving
tagline: Careful, well-organized moving for South Florida's luxury condos, high-rises, and single-family estates.
description: South Florida's premier residential buildings have strict requirements — elevator reservations, loading dock windows, COIs, and floor protection mandates. Our crews are trained for exactly this environment. We handle building compliance paperwork, protect every surface from lobby to unit, and deliver with the precision that Brickell, Aventura, and Sunny Isles properties demand. Whether you're moving from a waterfront penthouse or a Coral Gables estate, the standard never changes.

features.label: Pads & stretch wrap included as loaners

name: Long-Distance Moving Within Florida
tagline: Moves to anywhere else in Florida, quoted per job. Out of state we refer a licensed carrier.
description: Long-distance inside Florida - Orlando, Tampa, Naples, Jacksonville, the Panhandle - is quoted individually on distance, volume and access at both ends, not from a rate card. You get the figure in writing before anything is booked, and there is no deposit. What we do not do is cross a state line: moving household goods between states requires federal operating authority we do not hold, so we neither quote nor take those jobs. If you are leaving Florida, call anyway - we will name a licensed carrier, and packing or the Florida-side leg is still ours.

features.label: Out of state: referral to a licensed carrier

pricingNote:
Quoted individually by distance, volume and access at both ends.
- Anywhere in Florida
- Written estimate before booking, no deposit
- Out of state: not offered - we refer a licensed carrier

name: Office & Commercial
tagline: Office and business moves across Miami, Fort Lauderdale, and Boca Raton — scheduled around your hours, executed without disrupting operations.
description: Relocating a business in South Florida means working around office hours, building loading dock windows, and IT infrastructure that can't go down for long. We schedule around your timeline — evenings, weekends, or phased moves across multiple days — to keep disruption short. Our crews handle desks, workstations, monitors, server equipment, and AV systems with the same care we bring to residential work. Furniture is disassembled and reassembled on-site. Eugene stays directly involved on every commercial job, and you have one point of contact from first quote through the final placement.
pricingNote:
Pricing based on crew size, scope, and scheduling requirements.
• After-hours and weekend moves available
• Custom quotes for larger or complex projects

name: Fine Art & Specialty Items
tagline: Custom crating, climate-aware transport, and careful placement for irreplaceable pieces.
description: South Florida's art collectors, estate owners, and luxury residents trust us with pieces that have no replacement value. Grand pianos, museum-quality paintings, antique furniture, wine collections, and curated sculptures require specialist handling that goes beyond standard moving. We use custom crating built to piece dimensions, climate-aware loading and transport, and slow, deliberate placement at the destination. Every specialty move includes full documentation and photographic inventory.
pricingNote:
Every specialty move is quoted individually.
• Price depends on item count, size, and required crating
• Grand piano moves quoted separately
• Call or request a quote — we'll assess and give you a clear number

name: Storage Coordination
tagline: Moving and storage in South Florida — we handle pickup, secure climate-controlled storage in Miami-Dade, and redelivery when you're ready.
description: Between a closing and your new home, during a renovation, or when your destination isn't ready yet, we coordinate short- and long-term storage at trusted, climate-controlled facilities across Miami-Dade and Broward County. We pick up from your current address, deliver to the facility, and handle redelivery on your schedule — so you're not juggling a separate storage relationship. Month-to-month terms, no pressure. Facilities are secured, monitored, and selected based on what you're storing and how long you need it. We stay involved from pickup through final placement.
